app.title: Rošada – Battle of the Heroes
setup.title: New game
setup.mode.draftHelp: Light picks a hero, Dark picks both of theirs, Light picks its last hero. Every hero can be different.
setup.mode.mirrorHelp: Light picks the first hero for both sides, then Dark picks the second hero for both sides.
setup.pickMirror: {side} picks a hero for both sides
setup.orderHelp: {side} chooses which hero plays first and which Bishop each hero starts behind.
hud.selectUnit: Select a highlighted unit to Lead
hud.moveHelp: Click an adjacent square to move ({left} left)
dialog.advance: Choose where the hero ends next to the Led unit
dialog.unconscious: {hero} is Unconscious: choose a friendly tavern
dialog.retreatTavern: Choose a friendly tavern for Hero Retreat
dialog.inspired: How much Destiny for Inspired Lead?
dialog.problemsHelp: Fix these in sandbox, then switch the rules back on:
settings.title: Settings
settings.sandboxConfirm: Turn rule enforcement off? Pieces can then be moved freely and no result is declared.
sandbox.help: Drag or click a piece, then click a square. Click the Graveyard to remove a unit.
sandbox.physicsHelp: Drag a piece to pick it up; release to drop it. Pieces can knock each other over.
sandbox.settling: Waiting for pieces to come to rest…
notice.wellDepleted: The initial 16 Destiny are used up. The Epic Stage comes in a later version – play continues with Starting Heroes.
log.wellDepleted: The initial Destiny Well is used up
error.ABILITIES_BLOCKED: Blocked: the King was in check after the Lead, or no Lead was possible
error.BAD_AMOUNT: Choose an amount of at least 1 D
error.BAD_ANSWER: Choose one of the offered options
error.BAD_PAYMENT: The payment must add up to the cost
error.BAD_SQUARE: That square is not on the board
error.KING_THREATENED_SQUARE: A King may not be Led into a threatened square
error.LEAD_LEAVES_KING_IN_CHECK: That Lead would leave your King in check
error.LIGHT_FIRST: Light chooses its turn order first
error.MOVE_ENDS_ON_UNIT: A Move may not end on an enemy unit or a King
error.MUST_ATTEMPT_LEAD: A possible Lead must be attempted
error.NOT_ADJACENT: Move one adjacent square at a time
error.NOT_YOUR_HERO: Choose one of your side's heroes
error.NOT_YOUR_PICK: It is the other side's pick
error.OUT_OF_RANGE: That unit is not in Range
error.HERO_UNIT_SHARES: A Hero Unit shares its square with another unit
error.SANDBOX_MODE: Rules are off: only sandbox actions work
error.SETUP_INCOMPLETE: Pick heroes, turn order and starting squares first

favor.bloodyTheCastleGates.name: Bloody the Castle Gates
favor.bloodyTheCastleGates.requirement: Destroy an enemy unit in Battle in the enemy’s Royal rank.
favor.overwhelm.name: Overwhelm
favor.overwhelm.requirement: Ram an enemy hero 2 times, or 2 enemy heroes once each.
favor.greatIncursion.name: Great Incursion
favor.greatIncursion.requirement: Have 3 friendly non-hero units within the 4 ranks on the enemy’s side of the Battlefield.
favor.tacticalGenius.name: Tactical Genius
favor.tacticalGenius.requirement: Give a discovered check without Destroying a friendly unit with an ability.
favor.deployTroops.name: Deploy Troops
favor.deployTroops.requirement: Have 3 or fewer friendly pawns on friendly pawn starting squares.
favor.royalsFury.name: Royal’s Fury
favor.royalsFury.requirement: Destroy 3 units in Battle with Royalty (King and/or Queen).
favor.decimate.name: Decimate
favor.decimate.requirement: The enemy has 7 Destroyed main units in the Graveyard.
favor.offenseIsTheBestDefense.name: Offense is the Best Defense
favor.offenseIsTheBestDefense.requiremen: Threaten an enemy unit with 3 friendly units.
favor.vanquishYourFoes.name: Vanquish your Foes
favor.vanquishYourFoes.requirement: Bring an enemy hero to 0 Health, or bring 2 different enemy heroes to Bloodied.
favor.destinedForGreatness.name: Destined for Greatness
favor.destinedForGreatness.requirement: Have 20 or more Destiny on your side at End of Turn.
favor.tidesOfDestiny.name: Tides of Destiny
favor.tidesOfDestiny.requirement: After the initial 16 Destiny are depleted, gain Destiny in your Common Pool during your turn (up to 5 times).
favor.manifestEpicDestiny.name: Manifest Epic Destiny
favor.manifestEpicDestiny.requirement: Deplete the initial 16 Destiny in the Destiny Well.
power.heroUnit.name: Hero Unit
power.heroUnit.text: Heroes may become or stop being a Hero Unit (Short range: Knight, Long range: Bishop).
power.kingsForces.name: King’s Forces
power.kingsForces.text: Gain a King’s Forces token: spend it at Beginning of Turn to create an auxiliary unit of your hero’s type on its square.
power.advancedWarfare.name: Advanced Warfare
power.advancedWarfare.text: When becoming a Hero Unit you may become a Rook instead.
power.farReach.name: Far Reach
power.farReach.text: A Hero Unit’s Range is 4 instead of 2.
power.swiftChange.name: Swift Change
power.swiftChange.text: Hero Unit powers can also be used at End of Turn.
power.finalForm.name: Final Form
power.finalForm.text: When becoming a Hero Unit you may be a Rook and your own type at once.
tracker.title: Royal Favors
notice.epicStage: The Epic Stage begins: heroes choose their destiny.
error.POWER_LOCKED: Your side has not unlocked that Legendary Power yet
error.HERO_UNIT_OCCUPIED: A hero cannot become a Hero Unit on an occupied square
error.HERO_UNIT_OFF_BATTLEFIELD: A Hero Unit must be on the Battlefield
error.HERO_UNIT_WOULD_CHECK: A hero cannot become a Hero Unit where it would check the King
error.HERO_UNIT_IN_CHECK_PATH: Your King is in check and the hero stands in the path of that check
error.NOT_HERO_UNIT: That hero is not a Hero Unit
error.ALREADY_HERO_UNIT: That hero is already a Hero Unit
error.BAD_HERO_UNIT_TYPE: That Hero Unit type is not available
error.CREATE_WOULD_CHECK: A unit may never be created where it would give check
error.CREATE_OCCUPIED: A unit can only be created on an unoccupied square
error.RAMMED_BY_TARGET: A Hero Unit may not Lead itself into Battle with the unit that Rammed it last turn
log.heroUnitOff: {hero} is no longer a Hero Unit
log.warRemoved: The Declaration of War token is removed: no more War bonus
log.heroMoved.heroUnit: {hero} moves with its Hero Unit to {to}
log.heroMoved.heroUnitDestroyed: {hero} goes back to its starting square {to}
dialog.destinyTaken: Not with a {other} hero on the same side
ability.general.inspiredLead.name: Inspired Lead
ability.general.inspiredLead.text: Spend any amount of D: +2 to this turn's Lead per D.
ability.general.heroRetreat.name: Hero Retreat
ability.general.heroRetreat.text: Place your hero in a friendly tavern and get a free Drink.
ability.cavalier.warhorse.name: Warhorse
ability.cavalier.warhorse.text: Once per turn, you may move one square.
ability.cavalier.demoralise.name: Demoralise
ability.cavalier.demoralise.text: Mark yourself with the Demoralise token. While marked, if an enemy unit passes through a square adjacent to you and leaves your range, that Lead fails and the token is removed. If no enemy Lead fails due to it, remove it at the start of your next turn.
ability.cavalier.tightFormation.name: Tight Formation
ability.cavalier.tightFormation.text: Lead a friendly Knight without initiating Battle. It cannot be Destroyed in Battle on the next turn.
ability.deathKnight.auraOfFear.name: Aura of Fear
ability.deathKnight.auraOfFear.text: Enemy Leads in which the unit's path interacts with squares adjacent to you get a -2/-3 penalty.
ability.deathKnight.seekRevenge.name: Seek Revenge
ability.deathKnight.seekRevenge.text: After an adjacent friendly unit gets Destroyed, your next Lead gets a +2 bonus.
ability.deathKnight.paleSteed.name: Pale Steed
ability.deathKnight.paleSteed.text: You may move one square. Cannot be used while you are a Hero Unit.
ability.deathKnight.imNotDoneWithYou.tex: After you Destroy an enemy Pawn in Battle, create an undead auxiliary Pawn in that square.
ability.deathKnight.dutyBeyondTheGrave.t: Create an undead auxiliary Knight in an unoccupied starting square of its type.
ability.deathKnight.legendaryAncient.tex: Create the Legendary auxiliary unit in your square if it is unoccupied. It is Led one square in any direction, cannot be Led into Battle on the turn it was created, can use King's Banishment and King's Verdict, has 5 health and takes wounds as a hero, but can be Destroyed in Battle. Each time it is Led, it takes 1 wound.
ability.dragonLord.wingedStride.name: Winged Stride
ability.dragonLord.dragonMount.name: Dragon Mount
ability.dragonLord.dragonMount.text: You may move one square. Cannot be used while you are a Hero Unit.
ability.dragonLord.breathOfFieryDestruct: During Move: choose a square in the path of your Movement; deal 2 wounds to enemy heroes in that square. OR During Lead: while Leading a Knight, deal 3 wounds to enemy heroes in its path and Destroy enemy auxiliary units in its path.
ability.dragonLord.draconicDescent.name: Draconic Descent
ability.dragonLord.draconicDescent.text: Lead a Knight 2x2 squares instead of the standard 2x1 Knight path. It cannot be Led into Battle with royalty.
ability.dragonLord.terrifyingRoar.name: Terrifying Roar
ability.dragonLord.terrifyingRoar.text: Place your hero in a square occupied by an enemy unit not in its starting square adjacent to the friendly unit Led. Push that enemy unit one unoccupied square back towards its side of the board.
ability.dragonLord.greatWyrmOffering.tex: Destroy an unmodified adjacent enemy Pawn which is not on a starting square of its type. Create a friendly auxiliary Knight in its square.
ability.holyPaladin.auraOfRadiance.name: Aura of Radiance
ability.holyPaladin.auraOfRadiance.text: When a friendly unit adjacent to you is being Led by a friendly hero, that Lead gets a +1 bonus.
You may move one square. Cannot be used while you are a Hero Unit.
ability.holyPaladin.divineProtector.name: Divine Protector
ability.holyPaladin.divineProtector.text: Mark a friendly hero. Until the beginning of your next turn, that hero cannot be Pushed from that square, and any wounds they would take, you take instead. If a Lead passes through that hero's square, you take the Ram wounds and that hero is not pushed.
ability.holyPaladin.paragonOfHonor.name: Paragon of Honor
ability.holyPaladin.paragonOfHonor.text: Place the Paragon of Honour token on a friendly Queen until the beginning of your next turn. If that Queen is Destroyed in Battle while protected by a friendly Knight, you can pay 2 D more for that Knight to switch squares with the Queen and be Destroyed instead.
ability.holyPaladin.crusade.name: Crusade
ability.holyPaladin.crusade.text: Lead a friendly Knight. It cannot be Destroyed in Battle on the next turn. This Knight can still sacrifice itself for Paragon of Honor.
ability.holyPaladin.knightAPeasant.name: Knight a Peasant
ability.holyPaladin.knightAPeasant.text: Modify an adjacent friendly Pawn into a Knight.
ability.holyPaladin.holyWrath.name: Holy Wrath
ability.holyPaladin.holyWrath.text: Deal 4 wounds to an adjacent enemy hero on the Battlefield and Destroy an enemy unit adjacent to both of you.
ability.monk.rejuvenatingStroll.name: Rejuvenating Stroll
ability.monk.rejuvenatingStroll.text: Once per turn, heal a friendly hero for 1 wound while passing through that hero's square.
ability.monk.preaching.name: Preaching
ability.monk.preaching.text: Mark an adjacent enemy unit with the Preaching token. That unit has a -4 penalty to Lead on the next turn. If you spend both uses on it, that unit cannot be Led on the next turn.
ability.monk.makePeaceNotWar.name: Make Peace Not War
ability.monk.makePeaceNotWar.text: When the Declaration of War is active and your King is not in check: until the beginning of your next turn units may not be Destroyed, heroes do not take wounds, Leads don't require a roll and a Lead may not result in a check. If the King is Led into Battle or deals wounds to a hero, remove the token.
ability.cultist.righteousMight.name: Righteous Might
ability.cultist.righteousMight.text: Friendly auxiliary units in your square can only be Destroyed in Battle. Get +1 to Leads into Battle for each friendly auxiliary Pawn.
ability.cultist.spiritualHealing.name: Spiritual Healing
ability.cultist.spiritualHealing.text: Heal yourself 1 + 1 wound per adjacent friendly auxiliary unit.
ability.cultist.religiousFervor.name: Religious Fervor
ability.cultist.religiousFervor.text: Place a token on an adjacent square: it counts as occupied but does not prevent Leads through or onto it. At the end of your next turn it becomes an auxiliary Pawn; at the end of the turn after, an auxiliary Bishop is added there (Bloodied: straight to the Bishop). Removed when an enemy unit is Led onto or through it, or an enemy hero interacts with its square (that hero takes 3 wounds).
ability.cultist.knightmare.name: Knightmare
ability.cultist.knightmare.text: After forking with a Knight, mark that Knight and the 2 forked enemy units. They cannot be Led. At the beginning of your next turn, remove the marks.
ability.cultist.sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
ability.cultist.sacrifice.text: Mark a friendly Pawn. At the end of your next turn, remove the token, Destroy the Pawn if it is not on a starting square of its type and deal 3 wounds to enemy heroes within 2 squares of it.
ability.cultist.falseSalvation.name: False Salvation
ability.cultist.falseSalvation.text: Destroy an adjacent enemy Pawn that is not on a starting square of its type. Create a friendly auxiliary Pawn in that square / (Bloodied) return a Destroyed friendly main Pawn from the Graveyard to that square.
ability.cultist.dreamOfIllFate.name: Dream of Ill Fate
ability.cultist.dreamOfIllFate.text: Choose a type of unit. If an enemy hero Leads that type of unit on the next turn they take 4 wounds.
ability.saint.saintlyInspiration.name: Saintly Inspiration
ability.saint.saintlyInspiration.text: Heal a friendly hero for 2 wounds while passing through that hero's square.
ability.saint.sacredRite.name: Sacred Rite
ability.saint.sacredRite.text: Heal a friendly hero adjacent to a friendly Bishop for 4 wounds.
ability.saint.pilgrimage.name: Pilgrimage
ability.saint.pilgrimage.text: Lead a friendly Pawn forward, through one or more squares in its file occupied by enemy units, to the first unoccupied square not in the Royal Rank. This Lead does not Ram nor can it initiate Battle.
ability.saint.martyrdom.name: Martyrdom
ability.saint.martyrdom.text: All enemy units adjacent to you cannot be Led next turn. You take 2 wounds per unit and on your next turn your Movement becomes 1.
ability.saint.wingsOfDestiny.name: Wings of Destiny
ability.saint.wingsOfDestiny.text: Return one friendly Main unit from your Graveyard to an empty starting square of its type.
ability.supremeInquisitor.zealotMob.name: Zealot Mob
ability.supremeInquisitor.zealotMob.text: Deal 2 wounds to an enemy hero that makes a Lead whose path interacts with squares adjacent to you.
ability.supremeInquisitor.unexpectedVisi: If you moved 0 squares during your Move phase, you may move up to 3 squares.
ability.supremeInquisitor.inquisition.te: Modify an adjacent enemy unit into a Pawn until the end of your next turn.
Mark up to 2 enemy units adjacent to the unit which just Destroyed an enemy unit in Battle. Those units cannot initiate Battle next turn.
ability.supremeInquisitor.blindFaith.tex: Lead a friendly Pawn in range one square forward into Battle.
ability.supremeInquisitor.dogmaticIndoct: Destroy an adjacent unprotected enemy Bishop. Create a friendly auxiliary Bishop in that square.
ability.scout.elusive.name: Elusive
ability.scout.elusive.text: You take 2 wounds less from Ramming. You can choose to end your Move in an enemy unit's square; while there, units in that square cannot Ram you.
ability.scout.bearTraps.name: Bear Traps
ability.scout.bearTraps.text: Place the Bear Trap token in your square if it is unoccupied. Enemy Leads interacting with squares adjacent to it get a -3 penalty. When an enemy hero interacts with its square, they take 4 wounds and the trap is removed. It is also removed when an enemy unit is Led onto its square. It stays until removed, even in the Epic Stage.
ability.scout.poisonWater.name: Poison Water
ability.scout.poisonWater.text: Mark an enemy unit in your square. It cannot be Led on the next turn. Later Leads with that unit get a -3 penalty until the Epic Stage starts.
ability.scoundrel.elusiveSabotage.name: Elusive Sabotage
ability.scoundrel.elusiveSabotage.text: You take 2 wounds less from Ramming. You can end your Move in a square with enemy units; while there, units in that square cannot Ram you. Leads with an enemy unit in your square get a -3 penalty.
ability.scoundrel.bushwack.name: Bushwack
ability.scoundrel.bushwack.text: Deal 2/3 wounds to an adjacent enemy hero. If that hero is not a Hero Unit, push them one square straight away from you. If they are pushed into your friendly unit, deal 1 extra wound.
ability.scoundrel.massConfusion.name: Mass Confusion
ability.scoundrel.massConfusion.text: Promote a friendly main Pawn in range which is in an enemy Pawn's starting square.
ability.scoundrel.misdirection.name: Misdirection
ability.scoundrel.misdirection.text: Push an adjacent enemy Pawn, not on its starting square, one unoccupied square back towards its side of the board.
ability.scoundrel.deviousGambit.name: Devious Gambit
ability.scoundrel.deviousGambit.text: When an unprotected friendly unit adjacent to you is Destroyed in Battle, Destroy the unit that initiated the Battle.
ability.scoundrel.highTreason.name: High Treason
ability.scoundrel.highTreason.text: Destroy a friendly Queen in range and all enemy units adjacent to it.
ability.spyMaster.evasive.name: Evasive
ability.spyMaster.evasive.text: You take 2 wounds less from Ramming and, if Rammed, you may place yourself in the Smuggler's Grotto immediately. You can end your Move in a square with enemy units; while there, units in that square cannot Ram you.
ability.spyMaster.smugglersGrotto.name: Smuggler's Grotto
ability.spyMaster.smugglersGrotto.text: Place a Smuggler's Grotto token on a square in each wilderness. These are taverns accessible only to a Spy Master and their ally, and the 2 squares are adjacent to each other for them.
ability.spyMaster.misinformation.name: Misinformation
ability.spyMaster.misinformation.text: Push an enemy hero within your range 1 empty square in any direction. Not on an enemy Hero Unit.
ability.spyMaster.infiltrate.name: Infiltrate
ability.spyMaster.infiltrate.text: Mark a friendly Pawn in range with the Spy token and place it in an unoccupied square in its file in the enemy's Royal Rank. It is Modified and Led in the opposite direction of a normal friendly Pawn. Using this ability again removes the mark and returns it to an unoccupied starting Pawn square.
ability.spyMaster.mislead.name: Mislead
ability.spyMaster.mislead.text: Mark an enemy unit in range that is not on its starting square. That unit cannot be Led on the next turn.
ability.spyMaster.counterintelligence.te: Mark a friendly unit in range. It cannot be Led into Battle, and if an enemy unit Destroys it in Battle you may instead move it, as if Led, to an unoccupied square that does not check the King. The mark is removed at the beginning of your next turn.
ability.royalAssassin.patientPreparation: You take 2 wounds less from Ramming. You can end your Move in a square with enemy units; while there, units in that square cannot Ram you. If you move 0 squares during your Move phase, get +2 to Lead.
ability.royalAssassin.killOrder.name: Kill Order
ability.royalAssassin.killOrder.text: Mark an enemy unit in range. On your next and later turns, if you end your turn adjacent to it, it is Destroyed. The mark lasts until that unit is Destroyed or you use this ability again.
ability.royalAssassin.assassinateTheUnwo: Destroy an enemy unit adjacent to you and your King.
ability.royalAssassin.reapTheWeary.name: Reap the Weary
ability.royalAssassin.reapTheWeary.text: Drop a Bloodied enemy hero in the same square as you to 0 health.
ability.royalAssassin.redCarpet.name: Red Carpet
ability.royalAssassin.redCarpet.text: Lead your Queen into Battle with an enemy unit in range. After Destroying it, continue the Battle by Destroying the next unit in the Queen's path.
ability.royalAssassin.regicide.name: Regicide
ability.royalAssassin.regicide.text: Destroy an adjacent enemy Queen that was unprotected on this turn before your Lead. If the enemy has no Queen, this affects enemy Bishops the same way.
ability.magus.futureSight.name: Future Sight
ability.magus.futureSight.text: Take 1 wound. Get +2 to your next Lead.
ability.magus.flamingBolt.name: Flaming Bolt
ability.magus.flamingBolt.text: Deal 2 wounds to an enemy hero in range.
ability.magus.soulsClash.name: Souls Clash
ability.magus.soulsClash.text: Destroy an adjacent friendly Pawn. Then Destroy an enemy Pawn in the same file within 3 squares of it and heal yourself for 3 wounds.
ability.necromancer.graveSacrifice.name: Grave Sacrifice
ability.necromancer.graveSacrifice.text: For every 5 units in your Graveyard, gain 1 extra Destiny from Destiny Generation (End of Turn).
ability.necromancer.soulSyphon.name: Soul Syphon
ability.necromancer.soulSyphon.text: When an adjacent main unit is Destroyed, heal 2 wounds.
ability.necromancer.bloodRitual.name: Blood Ritual
ability.necromancer.bloodRitual.text: Take 2 wounds. Get a +3/+4 bonus to Lead.
ability.necromancer.leechingTouch.name: Leeching Touch
ability.necromancer.leechingTouch.text: Deal 2/4 wounds to an adjacent hero and heal yourself for 3 wounds. OR Destroy an adjacent enemy auxiliary unit and heal yourself for 2 wounds.
ability.necromancer.awakenTheDeathless.t: You take 3/2 wounds to create an undead Bishop or Knight in an empty starting square of its type.
ability.necromancer.undeadLegions.name: Undead Legions
ability.necromancer.undeadLegions.text: Create a friendly undead Pawn in all unoccupied Pawn starting squares. You take wounds equal to 1 + the number of Pawns created / (Bloodied) take 1 wound and you may instantly make a Lead without Battle with one of the created Pawns.
ability.grandArcanist.magicBombardment.t: Deal 2 wounds to a hero in range. OR Destroy an adjacent auxiliary unit.
ability.grandArcanist.arcaneShackles.tex: Mark an enemy unit in range not already marked by Arcane Shackles. It cannot be Led nor Destroyed in Battle until the end of your next turn.
ability.grandArcanist.conjurePortal.name: Conjure Portal
ability.grandArcanist.conjurePortal.text: Place 2 Portal tokens on 2 empty squares in range of the same colour, not in the enemy's Royal Rank. Portal squares are occupied; whatever ends on one is placed on the other. An enemy unit on either portal square is Battled by Leads interacting with those squares. Remove the Portals at your End of Turn, or when you use this ability again.
Create an auxiliary Demon unit in the unoccupied square you are in. It can only be Led into Battle and does not count for Destiny Generation. Using this ability again makes the previous Demon vanish.
ability.grandArcanist.fireball.name: Fireball
ability.grandArcanist.fireball.text: Place a Fireball token on a 2x2 area fully in your range. At the end of the next turn, heroes in that area take 5 wounds and tokens and units there are Destroyed. Then remove the token.
ability.chronomonger.noTimeToLose.name: No Time to Lose?
ability.chronomonger.noTimeToLose.text: When you fall Unconscious, you may choose not to lose your next turn. If you do so, return to your starting square with 1 health.
ability.chronomonger.certaintyAndDeath.t: Make a Lead with a friendly unit in range; it automatically succeeds. Mark that unit: its next Lead also succeeds automatically, but it is Destroyed at the end of that turn. Using this ability again Destroys the previously marked unit at the end of your turn. Not on Hero Units.
ability.chronomonger.rapidMarch.name: Rapid March
ability.chronomonger.rapidMarch.text: When Leading a Pawn in a starting square of its type, Lead it 3 squares forward. En passant cannot be used against this Pawn.
ability.chronomonger.timeyWimeyShift.tex: Switch your turn order and Turn Order token with an allied hero and pass the Active Hero token to them.
ability.chronomonger.convergeTimelines.t: After a successful Lead that did not check with that unit, create an auxiliary unit of the same type where the Lead began. If one of the two is Destroyed the other becomes the original; after a Lead with one, that one is the original. If both remain at the beginning of your next turn, choose one to remove. Not on Hero Units.
ability.chronomonger.temporalFlux.name: Temporal Flux
ability.chronomonger.temporalFlux.text: Place the Temporal Flux token on your starting square. While active, Destroyed friendly units (not royalty, not Hero Units) are immediately created on an unoccupied starting square of their type. Remove the token if it is destroyed or at the end of your next turn.
